subject: general
question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 10.5°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 3 : 4, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Angle between bisectors of ∠R and ∠S = 180 − (R/2 + S/2)

Given ∠STR = 10.5° ⇒ 10.5 = 180 − (R+S)/2

⇒ (R+S)/2 = 169.5 ⇒ R+S = 339°

In quadrilateral: P + Q + R + S = 360 ⇒ P + Q = 21°

Ratio P : Q = 3 : 4 ⇒ Difference = (1/7) × 21 = 3°

**∴ Answer = 3°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quadrilateral PQRS, bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at T, ∠STR = 10.5°, P : Q = 3 : 4

**Formula used:**

Angle between internal bisectors = 180 − (sum of half of the angles)

 
 P Q R S 
• 
• T 10.5° 

Bisectors of ∠R and ∠S intersect at T

**Calculation:**

⇒ ∠STR = 180 − (R/2 + S/2)

⇒ 10.5 = 180 − (R+S)/2

⇒ (R+S)/2 = 169.5

⇒ R + S = 339°

⇒ Sum of angles in quadrilateral = 360°

⇒ P + Q + R + S = 360

⇒ P + Q = 360 − 339 = 21°

⇒ Let P = 3x, Q = 4x

⇒ 7x = 21 ⇒ x = 3

⇒ P = 9°, Q = 12°

**∴ The correct answer is 3°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle Sum of Quadrilateral

Sum of interior angles = 360°. Useful to find unknown angles when others are known.

Angle Bisector Property

Angle bisector divides an angle into two equal parts: θ/2 and θ/2.

Intersection of Bisectors

Angle between bisectors of adjacent angles = 180 − (sum of half angles).

Ratio Method

If P : Q = 3 : 4 and P+Q is known, then P = (3/7)×total and Q = (4/7)×total.
